title.zh: MoonPay to buy North Capital in all-stock deal worth over $60M
title.en: MoonPay to buy North Capital in all-stock deal worth over $60M

current_state.zh: MoonPay agreed to acquire private-markets infrastructure provider North Capital in an all-stock deal worth over $60 million, adding a US broker-dealer and trading infrastructure to support expansion into tokenized securities and real-world assets.
